Sent

It reached a person.

Not a queue and not an autoresponder that pretends to be one. You will get a real reply, usually the same day and at the latest within one business day.

Back to the site

What happens now

  1. An acknowledgement, in a minute or two

    It has a link to work we have done in it. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder and then write to hello@ordence.com directly.

  2. A conversation, usually within a day

    Thirty to forty-five minutes, mostly us asking how work actually moves through your business. No slides.

  3. A written scope and a fixed number

    Modules, users, what we migrate, what we build, and what we are not doing. Yours to keep and circulate whether or not you go ahead.

  4. Then you decide

    If it is not right, tell us. We would rather hear no than manage a project that should not have started.

While you wait.

The worked example walks one business through the whole thing, module by module, including the part that was dropped because a whiteboard already solved it.
